title: Trend AI Cleaner One Pro Link Following Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows local attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of Trend Micro Cleaner One Pro. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the Junk Files Cleanup functionality. By creating a junction, an attacker can abuse the service to delete arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete files in the context of SYSTEM.
addtionnal_details:
Trend Micro has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://helpcenter.trendlife.com/en-us/article/TMKA-13319
timeline:
